correctness.rationale: After conditioning on e, all residual perfect matchings are uniform. For given t, choosing t vertices from each arc and bijecting them, then matching each even-sized residual arc, gives every feasible class and excludes all other degrees. Conditional arc-label symmetry applies to the four pair types in RESULT.md lines 27–42: two internal chords on one arc have one alternating pattern out of three pairings; an internal and bridge chord alternate iff the bridge endpoint is the middle of three exchangeable positions; two bridges have one alternating bijection out of two; internal chords on opposite arcs cannot alternate. With p=(a−t)/2 and q=(b−t)/2, this yields E[Y|D=t]=(p(p−1)+q(q−1))/6+t(p+q)/3+t(t−1)/4. The quadratic terms cancel and the linear coefficient is (a+b−1)/12=(2n−3)/12. Adding t correctly shifts the slope for K. This includes deterministic D. Counting one bridge or an ordered pair of disjoint bridges gives the factorial moments in lines 44–52 and their stated variance; the covariance then follows by conditional expectation.
